Container.Name: valheim-thunderstore
Container.Overview: Valheim dedicated server with Thunderstore mod support.[br][br] - Installs mods (and their dependencies) straight from thunderstore.io: list them by name or paste an r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager profile code.[br] - Keeps Valheim and your mods up to date automatically, waiting until nobody is online before restarting.[br] - Lets you choose the world seed, difficulty preset and world modifiers for new worlds.[br] - Backs up the world before every restart and saves cleanly on stop.[br][br] First start downloads about 1 GB of server files, so give it a few minutes. Forward UDP 2456-2457 on your router to play over the internet.
Container.Requires: About 2 GB of disk for server files, 4 GB+ of RAM (more with many mods).

Config.Name: Game port
Config.Description: Valheim game port. Keep host and container port the same as SERVER_PORT.

Config.Name: Query port
Config.Description: Steam query port (game port + 1). Used for the server browser and the player count.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Worlds (saves/), backups, mod configs (bepinex-config/), your own plugins (custom-plugins/) and logs.

Config.Name: Server files
Config.Description: Valheim server files, BepInEx and installed mods. Can be deleted; everything here is re-downloaded.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name shown in the server browser.

Config.Name: World name
Config.Description: World to load or create (letters and numbers, no spaces recommended). Changing it starts a new world; the old one stays in saves/.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: At least 5 characters, and must not be part of the server name.

Config.Name: World seed
Config.Description: Seed for a NEW world (1-10 characters, e.g. HHcLC5acQt). Leave empty for random. Has no effect on a world that already exists.

Config.Name: Public
Config.Description: List the server in the in-game community server browser.

Config.Name: Crossplay
Config.Description: Allow Xbox / Microsoft Store players (uses PlayFab; the player count for idle updates is not available with crossplay).

Config.Name: Admins
Config.Description: SteamID64s of admins, separated by commas. Leave empty to manage saves/adminlist.txt yourself.

Config.Name: Mods
Config.Description: Thunderstore mods, separated by commas: Author-ModName (always latest), Author-ModName-1.2.3 (pinned) or the mod's thunderstore.io link. Dependencies and BepInEx are installed automatically. Example: ValheimModding-Jotunn, Azumatt-AzuCraftyBoxes

Config.Name: Profile code
Config.Description: Optional. In r2modman or Thunderstore Mod Manager: Settings, Profile, Export profile as code. Installs the same mods as your client profile (saved locally, so it keeps working after the code expires).

Config.Name: Exclude mods
Config.Description: Mods never to install, e.g. client-only UI mods from your profile. Same format as Mods.

Config.Name: Pin profile versions
Config.Description: true = keep the exact mod versions from the profile instead of updating them.

Config.Name: Import profile configs
Config.Description: Copy config files from the profile code (only files you don't already have).

Config.Name: Always install BepInEx
Config.Description: Install BepInEx even with no Thunderstore mods. Happens automatically when custom-plugins/ has files.

Config.Name: Auto update
Config.Description: Check for Valheim and mod updates in the background and restart to apply them. Updates are always applied when the container starts.

Config.Name: Update Valheim
Config.Description: Include Valheim itself in background updates.

Config.Name: Update mods
Config.Description: Include Thunderstore mods in background updates.

Config.Name: Update check interval
Config.Description: Minutes between update checks.

Config.Name: Only update when empty
Config.Description: Wait until no players are online before restarting for an update.

Config.Name: Max wait for empty server
Config.Description: Minutes to wait for an empty server before restarting anyway (0 = wait forever).

Config.Name: Steam branch
Config.Description: Valheim branch, e.g. public or public-test.

Config.Name: Steam branch password
Config.Description: Password for a protected branch (public-test uses yesimadebackups).

Config.Name: Difficulty preset
Config.Description: Optional: normal, casual, easy, hard, hardcore, immersive or hammer.

Config.Name: World modifiers
Config.Description: Optional, comma separated name:value. combat (veryeasy-veryhard), deathpenalty (casual-hardcore), resources (muchless-most), raids (none-muchmore), portals (casual, hard, veryhard). Example: combat:hard, raids:none

Config.Name: World keys
Config.Description: Optional, comma separated: nomap, playerevents, passivemobs, nobuildcost, fire, teleportall

Config.Name: Backup on restart
Config.Description: Save a .tar.gz of the world to backups/ before every start.

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Number of world backups to keep.

Config.Name: Server port
Config.Description: Only change together with both port mappings (host and container) above.

Config.Name: Extra server arguments
Config.Description: Passed straight to valheim_server, e.g. -saveinterval 600 -backups 4

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are owned by (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are owned by (100 = users).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and backup names.
